result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, so your example gives Anna 1 and Bob 1 for the North/South setup in the test.

- **Fix:** in `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, around line 6518), the purchase-order subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`. That is the same filter the quarterly and latest purchase-order queries use.
- **Test:** added `leavesOutCancelledPurchaseOrders` to `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest`, with one sent and two cancelled South orders, plus a small helper to create a purchase order with a given status.

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` (4 tests) and `DemoScenarioTest` pass offline. Nothing is committed.

I did not touch the per-country purchase-order count (`findPurchaseOrderCountPerCountry`), which also counts cancelled orders. It is outside this report, but it has the same problem if you want it fixed too.
